<description>
There are several small sanitizer option issues:

* Using the project's default settings outside of CI is only possible manually
* Modifying the project's default requires modifying three places (docs, ci, and the fuzz runner)

Fix both issues by adding a `with_sanitizer_env.py ...cmd...` command wrapper that sets the default values.

Also, enable https://clang.llvm.org/docs/ThreadSanitizer.html#adaptive-delay, which may help to find some kind of rare races more frequently.
</description>

<commits>
fad2fc5a0f doc: Remove section on how to install libasan etc

The package name depends on the system and it should be trivial for a
developer to install it in any way.

faf907fd13 test: Add with_sanitizer_env.py

To run a command with default sanitizer options.

This allows to de-duplicate the various places where options are
hard-coded.

Also, it should be easier to run tests locally with the options applied.

fafce3be39 test: Set tsan enable_adaptive_delay=1 by default

fa0d826eac test: Use sanitizer env in functional tests by default

This allows to run the functional tests without having to manually set
the sanitizer env.
</commits>

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Copyright (c) The Bitcoin Core developers
+# Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying
+# file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit/.
+"""Run a command with default sanitizer options.
+
+Values already present in the environment take precedence over these defaults.
+"""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+SOURCE_DIR = Path("@PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR@")
+
+
+def sanitizer_env():
+    suppressions_dir = SOURCE_DIR / "test" / "sanitizer_suppressions"
+    return {
+        "ASAN_OPTIONS": (
+            "detect_leaks=1:detect_stack_use_after_return=1:check_initialization_order=1:strict_init_order=1"
+        ),
+        "LSAN_OPTIONS": (
+            f"suppressions={suppressions_dir / 'lsan'}:print_suppressions=0"
+        ),
+        "TSAN_OPTIONS": (
+            f"suppressions={suppressions_dir / 'tsan'}:halt_on_error=1:second_deadlock_stack=1:enable_adaptive_delay=1"
+        ),
+        "UBSAN_OPTIONS": (
+            f"suppressions={suppressions_dir / 'ubsan'}:print_stacktrace=1:halt_on_error=1:report_error_type=1"
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) == 1:
+        print(f"Usage: {Path(sys.argv[0]).name} COMMAND [ARG]...", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    env = sanitizer_env() | os.environ
+    return subprocess.run(sys.argv[1:], env=env).returncode
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
